hypotheses.question: Are corner features repeatable from lap to lap?
hypotheses.detail: Minimum speed and throttle features repeat; braking points barely persist across weekends.

hypotheses.question: Do teammates differ by more than the measurement error? (pilot)
hypotheses.detail: Norris vs Piastri, 2024 Abu Dhabi: too few laps for any test to pass, as predicted in advance.

hypotheses.question: Do corner features identify the driver on unseen sessions?
hypotheses.detail: Replicated on the frozen 2025 season (development: 0.685 vs 0.565). Not better than whole-lap statistics (0.680).

hypotheses.question: Does the signature follow drivers who change teams?
hypotheses.detail: Drivers who stay keep their signature (10 of 11; development 17 of 20). Across a team change it was not shown; control: stayers 8 of 10 (exploratory).
